No mathematical gap: the content is proved intrinsically.

findings: Prop. 4 (benzecri1960_ch3.tex:599-605) is FALSE as printed: the open quarter {y>0, z>0} of S(2) is a nonempty open convex part of empty noyau with infinitely many simple distinguished subvarieties (the pairs {±(t e1 + e2)}, t ∈ R), so 'les p sous-variétés distinguées simples' and a finite sum w = F⁻¹(F(v_1) × … × F(v_p)) over them do not exist (Benzecri.BooleProjectifInstance.not_prop4_simplesS_finite). The failure is the line x ↦ (x,1,1) in F(w), which 'noyau vide' does not exclude; it is the same defect as Déf. 6 / Th. 3's Corollary (OQ-168).

Under the added hypothesis ¬ ContientDroite (F w) (and w nonempty), both assertions hold, proved for every finite-dimensional real normed E: prop4_somme (the simple ones are finitely many, 1 ≤ p ≤ n+1, and w is the sum, Déf. 5, of the v_i = s(P_{l_i}(F(w))), each a nonempty convex part of support l_i, open in l_i, unique among convexes contained in the l_i) and prop4_permute / prop4_automorphisme_compatible (every projective automorphism of w is a linear g permuting the l_i and their summands: Ch. 1 Déf. 2's formula with φ_i = g, t = 1).

The printed proof (l.606-608) is complete only modulo two facts it leaves implicit, both formalized: F(w) is convex for w open with no line in its closed cone (Hyps4.convex_F, so w is connected and an automorphism is ONE element of GS(n), Ch. 1 Prop. 1), and the lift g of an automorphism preserves w (rigidity of GS on the open w, GSE.eq_one_of_eqOn).

In Chapter 1's notation the compatible form needs t ≠ 1 in general: the conical isomorphisms φ_i of Déf. 2 are morphisms for the cone groupoid GU (|det| = 1), so g|F(v_{τ(i)}) must be rescaled by |det|^{-1/(n_i+1)} and the scalars collected in t ∈ R^{+p}/R^+; the printed proof does not mention t (it is not needed in w's own coordinates).
questions: OQ-168 (OPEN): which corrected hypothesis is of record. The reading taken: w open with ¬ ContientDroite (F w) (the hypotheses of theoreme3 / corollaire_algebre_parties_projective); the label stays unmarked until the ruling.

« w = F⁻¹(F(v_1) × … × F(v_p)) » is read (dispatch reading (2)) as a projective isomorphism PiBase n B ≃ₜ w, B_i = s(b_i(F(v_i))) ⊆ S(n_i) through bases b_i : l_i ≅ R^{n_i+1} (stated: prop4_produit); its content, F(w) = ⊕ F(v_i) (Déf. 5's sum), is prop4_somme.
« w » is read nonempty (an empty w has p = 0 and is not the empty sum).

« automorphisme projectif de w » is read GXAut (GSR m) (S m) w for w as an open subset of S(m); « compatible » in w's own coordinates is read: g(l_{τ(i)}) = l_i, g(F(v_{τ(i)})) = F(v_i), g(Σ x_j) = Σ_i g(x_{τ(i)}); the Ch. 1 reading (IsCompatiblePi on PiBase) is prop4_produit, stated.
'GP(n, R)' in the proof (l.607) is read as GS(n, R) = GL(n+1)/R^+ acting on S(n) (the group of the projective structure), not as a separately defined group.

kb_proposals: Chapter3/BalayableSomme: for an open convex w of S(E) with no line in F(w), (∑T, ∑(S∖T)) is a conjugate pair for every set T of simple ones (Hyps4.conj_sSup); conjugate pairs mix (P_L x + P_L' y ∈ F(w), mix_of_conj), and a Finset induction on T gives ∑ P_i x_i ∈ F(w): the decomposition F(w) = ⊕ P_i(F(w)) (prop4_somme).

To compute with the projections P_i of a decomposition E = ⊕ l_i, prove linear-map identities by checking them on each simple subspace (Hyps4.linearMap_ext: sSup S ≤ LinearMap.eqLocus f g), with P_i x = if i = k then x else 0 for x ∈ l_k (projS_apply_l).

A GXAut of an open w ⊆ S(m) is one element of GS(m) when w is preconnected: exists_smul_eq_on_of_isPreconnected with φ = chartAt (S m) x₀ on the Opens (source univ) and ψ = φ.trans_aut f (exists_linearEquiv_of_gxAut); lift through QuotientGroup.mk_surjective and GSE.mk_smul.
Inside a `namespace Foo` with a structure `Foo`, `mk` resolves to `Foo.mk`: write `Sphere.mk` explicitly (Hyps4).
